title: cache-hit-sensitivity-analysis-2026
content:
PURPOSE
Quick working sheet: estimate monthly cost impact from prefix + KV caching under plausible hit-rate scenarios and do a small sensitivity sweep on per-million-token cost. Goal: decide whether to prioritize prefix cache rollout (low-effort) vs. investing in richer KV-layer (more infra work) for Q2 roadmap.

ASSUMPTIONS (baseline)
- Monthly requests: 10,000,000 (10M) requests/month (target customer workload for a mid-size SaaS integration).
- Baseline average tokens per request (input+output): 250 tokens.
- Average prefix tokens that can be saved when prefix cache hits: 80 tokens (common for long system prompts + repeated metadata).
- Average KV-cache saving on decode (re-usable KV sequences): 40 tokens when hit.
- Cost: USD per 1M tokens = $5 (default compute + infra). We'll sweep $3, $5, $8 for sensitivity.
- We assume prefix and KV hits are independent for first-pass (overlap caveat below).

DERIVED BASELINE
- Baseline monthly tokens = 10,000,000 * 250 = 2,500,000,000 tokens = 2,500M tokens
- Baseline monthly cost (@$5 / 1M) = 2,500 * $5 = $12,500

SCENARIO TABLE (planned rows in sheet)
Columns: scenario_label | prefix_hit% | kv_hit% | avg_saved_tokens_per_req | eff_tokens_per_req | monthly_tokens (M) | cost_per_1M | monthly_cost_USD | savings_USD | savings_pct | comments

Rows (sample calculations):
1) baseline | 0% | 0% | 0 | 250 | 2500M | $5 | $12,500 | $0 | 0% | no caching
2) A: low combos | 30% | 20% | (0.3*80)+(0.2*40)=24+8=32 | 218 | 2,180M | $5 | $10,900 | $1,600 | 12.8% | modest wins from both caches
3) B: mid combos | 60% | 50% | 48+20=68 | 182 | 1,820M | $5 | $9,100 | $3,400 | 27.2% | strong improvement
4) C: high ops | 90% | 70% | 72+28=100 | 150 | 1,500M | $5 | $7,500 | $5,000 | 40.0% | optimistic upper bound
5) D: kv-only | 0% | 70% | 0+28=28 | 222 | 2,220M | $5 | $11,100 | $1,400 | 11.2% | shows KV-only returns
6) E: prefix-only | 70% | 0% | 56+0=56 | 194 | 1,940M | $5 | $9,700 | $2,800 | 22.4% | prefix heavy wins

SENSITIVITY: cost per 1M tokens
- Repeat B (mid combos) with per-1M costs: $3, $5, $8
  * monthly_tokens = 1,820M -> cost @ $3 = $5,460; @ $5 = $9,100; @ $8 = $14,560
  * baseline @ $3 = 2,500M *3 = $7,500; savings @ $3 = $2,040 (27.2% relative)
  * relative % savings is invariant to unit cost; absolute $ savings scale with unit cost.

OTHER METRICS / NOTES
- Effective request-level latency: prefix hits reduce request tokenization + model input length -> small latency reduction on forward pass. KV hits reduce decode token counts -> reduces per-token compute and should lower tail p99 for long outputs. Quantify in perf bench.
- Bandwidth/egress: token reduction reduces egress and logging volumes. Estimate 40% of cost savings may show up as reduced infra load (GPU cycles) vs 60% as lower variable cloud egress depending on billing mix. Need infra billing breakdown.
- Overlap/correlation caveat: prefix hits often correlate with KV opportunities (e.g., repeated conversation content). Treat independence as conservative first-order model; we should instrument actual hit co-occurrence.
- Cold-starts and TTL: hit-rates above assume warmed caches. TTL policy and eviction will materially affect realized rates.

SAMPLE CALC NOTES (how to compute in sheet)
- saved_prefix_tokens = prefix_hit_frac * avg_prefix_tokens
- saved_kv_tokens = kv_hit_frac * avg_kv_tokens
- avg_saved_tokens_per_req = saved_prefix_tokens + saved_kv_tokens
- eff_tokens_per_req = max(1, baseline_tokens - avg_saved_tokens_per_req)
- monthly_tokens_M = (monthly_requests * eff_tokens_per_req) / 1,000,000
- monthly_cost = monthly_tokens_M * unit_cost_per_1M

IMPACT BREAKDOWN (rough CPU/GPU split assumptions)
- If 70% of variable cost is GPU compute and 30% is networking/logging/storage, then a 27% token reduction translates approx to 19% GPU-dollar reduction + 8% other-dollars. Confirm with infra billing.

RECOMMENDATIONS (short)
- Short-term (Q1): enable prefix cache A/B for 5 pilot customers -> measure actual prefix_hit%, avg saved tokens, and p95/p99 latency impact. Add metrics: prefix_hit_ratio, avg_saved_prefix_tokens, per-route token-savings. (Owner: Priya)
- Mid-term (Q2): prototype KV cache internal infra RFC; run a small canary in dedicated cluster; measure KV-hit rate and engineering ops cost. (Owner: Ethan)
- Instrumentation: add a new Console dashboard tile for "cache-hit token savings" aggregated by route and model. Hook to rollout feature flags. (Owner: Maya)
- Cost model update: plug measured hit rates into master cost model spreadsheet (linked in confluence) and recalc. If measured combined hit-rate > 40% consistently, prioritize KV engineering time.

OPEN QUESTIONS / TODOs
- TODO: get infra cost split (GPU vs networking) from finance (ticket FIN-623).
- TODO: produce micro-bench to estimate p95 latency improvement for prefix hits vs KV hits (bench harness in infra repo).
- Q: expected TTL/eviction hit rates under multitenant workloads? Need production trace sampling.
- Q: legal/data-sensitivity for caching customer prompts (PII). Need security review (Sec ticket SEC-88).

RAW CSV EXPORT EXAMPLE (paste to sheet col A):
scenario_label,prefix_hit_pct,kv_hit_pct,avg_saved_tokens_per_req,eff_tokens_per_req,monthly_tokens_M,cost_per_1M,monthly_cost_USD,savings_USD,savings_pct,notes
baseline,0,0,0,250,2500,$5,12500,0,0%,no-caching
A-low,30,20,32,218,2180,$5,10900,1600,12.8%,both small hits
B-mid,60,50,68,182,1820,$5,9100,3400,27.2%,promising
C-high,90,70,100,150,1500,$5,7500,5000,40%,upper-bound
D-kv-only,0,70,28,222,2220,$5,11100,1400,11.2%,KV focused
E-prefix-only,70,0,56,194,1940,$5,9700,2800,22.4%,prefix focused

CONTACTS / OWNERSHIP
- Doc owner: Sofia Martinez (product)
- Eng leads to consult: Ethan Zhao (infra), Maya Patel (console), Priya Nair (product ops)

NEXT STEPS (immediate)
- Create JIRA epic PROD-1423 with sub-tasks: instrument metrics, run pilot on 3 customers, bench p95 improvement, update cost-model with measured hits.
- Schedule 30-min sync with infra + finance to get cost split and confirm unit cost assumptions.

NOTES (informal)
- This is a working/rough model + quick numbers. Resist over-precision — we want order-of-magnitude guidance for prioritization.
- If you paste the CSV block into a new Google Sheet, formulas for saved tokens -> costs are straightforward. I'll maintain the canonical sheet once we have pilot numbers.

END OF SHEET (draft)
